Their background is heavily focused on web, JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and open-source GIS tools, with no evidence of financial systems development or Windows-based high-performance C++ work.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Demonstrated open-source contributions and technical leadership
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops and talks
concerns: No visible C++ or Windows platform experience in professional context
Absence of fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
SQL experience listed but no mention of SQL Server or Oracle, critical for role
